name: Brothers in Arms: Earned in Blood

locations.note: Hartsock's squad takes part in the liberation and defence of Carentan after D-Day.
The squad fights toward the link-up between the 82nd and 101st Airborne divisions.
The closing missions follow Hartsock's men into and around this Normandy town.

routes.name: Sgt. Joe Hartsock
routes.note: Newly given his own squad, Hartsock fights through the liberation and defence of Carentan, the link-up with the 82nd at Baupte, and the closing battles around Saint-Sauveur-le-Vicomte.
